units: (white intensity in [0,1])^2, per camera (list) or one value for every camera
derivation: modelling choice, not a measured sensor variance: a binary pixel is the thresholded coverage of a boundary pixel; if that coverage is unknown and uniform in [0,1], its variance about the 0/1 value is 1/12. The masks carry no segmentation-uncertainty estimate.
correlation_note: the masks are segmentations of the same RGB images as the RGB-D rows; R = blockdiag(R_rgbd, R_mask) is a composite-likelihood approximation that ignores that correlation
